summary_en: Acquisition of all shares in Kaisha Raito, an AI service development and operations company with operating profit and revenue up to ¥250M. Target to become wholly owned subsidiary. Supplemental disclosure materials.
title_en: Supplemental disclosure materials regarding acquisition of all shares in Kaisha Raito, an AI service development and operations company with operating profit and revenue up to ¥250M, for wholly owned subsidiary status
translation_en_brief: Ureru Net Advertising Group Co., Ltd. (ticker 9235) has filed supplemental disclosure materials regarding its acquisition of all shares in Kaisha Raito, an AI service development and operations company. The target company is described as operationally profitable with revenue up to ¥250 million. Upon completion of the transaction, Kaisha Raito will become a wholly owned subsidiary of the filer. The document serves as supplemental explanatory material for the acquisition; specific deal value, share count, and settlement date are not disclosed in the excerpt provided.
